title: Category and subcategory summaries
name: Category and subcategory summaries
audience: Human or agent arriving at one part of the manual
trigger: Open a category from contents, a breadcrumb or a contextual help pointer
proposed_purpose: Explain the category enough to choose the right deeper page.
content: What this category is for, in two or three sentences.
The few terms needed to distinguish its children.
A short relationship sketch where useful: for example QA method → plan/case → bound requirement → attempts/evidence/review.
Links to immediate children with a one-line reason to read each.
Prerequisites or support limits that change the user’s choice.
Related concepts and the next likely action; link exact command help for execution.
authority_and_reuse: Author the introduction once in the category landing; generate breadcrumbs and child links from the shared tree. Technical definitions and operation recipes stay in their canonical detail homes. Do not force empty single-child categories.
proposal_status: Proposed documentation shape, not a new runtime subsystem
plan_notes: Documentation organization proposal: outside current locked item details
